notes: IDs are always 15 chars (from EventLogFile CSV). If you got an 18-char ID from SOQL (ApiTotalUsageEventLog) strip the last 3 chars: 8888Z000000pihzQAA → 8888Z000000pihz
888-prefix IDs: contact Salesforce Support to identify. Not visible in Setup UI.
0H4-prefix IDs: look up in Salesforce Setup → Apps → Connected Apps
